verdict.rationale: The docs name an alternative project-local install: copy the skill folders into the repo's `.claude/skills/`, which can be committed with the project. The phrase 'instead of global' implies a global default, and the plugin marketplace install is shown, but neither the global location nor its scope is spelled out. Project-local scope also relies on a manual copy rather than a scope flag or option. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented user-global install path or scope, a first-class scope selector rather than a manual copy, guidance on committing the local skills, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects

citations.quote: Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
